answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a per-identity collateral lock. Each agent escrows capital that must stay live each epoch it earns or votes, so a host wanting many voices funds many separate locks, leaving that capital idle. The cost is the locked funds per epoch, not a one-off fee, and a flagged puppet is slashed, so repeats start from zero. Reward per epoch must stay small against the deposit: an honest operator sees working capital, a farmer sees a sum he cannot scale. Honest agents grow like a tended orchard; the fake sparrow flock drains toward its nadir, each identity adding a lock.
